title: Release check: a failed deploy, read from its output
summary: Callouts, a quote, a console session and a service log in one page. Explanatory: no questions.

blocks.text: The 2.4.0 deploy stopped at the migration step. The output below is copied from the run.
Do not re-run the deploy until the lock is released. A second run waits on the same lock.

blocks.title: The deploy command
blocks.code:
$ ./deploy --env prod --version 2.4.0
connecting to prod-db
running 3 migrations
warning: migration 0042 holds a table lock
error: migration 0043 timed out after 30s
$ echo $?
1
blocks.caption: Lines that start with `$` are commands.

blocks.title: The database log
blocks.code:
2026-10-21T09:14:02Z INFO  migrate: start 0042
2026-10-21T09:14:02Z DEBUG lock: acquire orders
2026-10-21T09:14:05Z WARN  lock: orders held for 3s
2026-10-21T09:14:35Z ERROR migrate: 0043 timed out
2026-10-21T09:14:35Z INFO  migrate: rollback 0043
blocks.caption: A debug line is dimmed. A warning and an error are coloured.

blocks.text: Migration 0042 adds an index without `CONCURRENTLY`, so it blocks writes to `orders`.
Add the index with `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` and run the migration outside a transaction.
Dropping the lock by killing the session rolls back every open order write.
The deploy is safe to retry once the index is rebuilt. Not before.
